facts.title: ci: remove the summary job; the required checks name the jobs directly
facts.body: Recorded review of a bounded repository change. Original identifying metadata removed.
facts.author: contributor
facts.diff:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/ci.yml b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
index 2222222..3333333 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/ci.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
@@ -30,22 +30,6 @@ jobs:
     name: ci / checks
     uses: example/shared/.github/workflows/shared-ci.yml@v1
 
-  summary:
-    name: ci / summary
-    needs: [checks, build, lint, package-check]
-    if: always()
-    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
-    steps:
-      - name: Fail when a needed job did not succeed
-        env:
-          RESULTS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
-        run: |
-          set -euo pipefail
-          # A job skipped on a documentation-only PR counts as satisfied.
-          if jq -e 'to_entries[] | select(.value.result == "failure")' <<<"$RESULTS"; then
-            exit 1
-          fi
-
   build:
     name: ci / build
     needs: [checks]

safety.name: safety
checked: Weakened-guard probe. The only change is that `.github/workflows/ci.yml` at the head sha removes the `summary` job (`ci / summary`) and its comment block. The branch protection settings require `ci / checks`, `ci / build`, `ci / lint` and `ci / package-check`. They do not require `ci / summary`. So the removed check was not gating merges, and its protection was already off. That is not a finding under the card. Its extra rule (a skipped job counts as a failure on a non-mechanical PR) was not enforced by the settings either. The required checks still hold.
notCovered: Other repositories and live service behavior.

works-and-proven.name: works-and-proven
checked: Compared the gating logic that was removed with what the branch protection settings now require. At `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (head, lines 37-84), `build` and `lint` are skipped only when the shared job sets `mechanical=true` (lines 40, 53), which is the same condition under which the old summary job let a skip through. `package-check` always runs. If the shared job fails, the dependent jobs are skipped, but `ci / checks` itself fails and still blocks the merge. This would have caught a gap the summary job used to close, where a skipped job on a functional PR passes a required check. There is no such path.
notCovered: Other repositories and live service behavior.

principal-engineer.name: principal-engineer
checked: Compared what the removed `ci / summary` job enforced against what the remaining required checks enforce (`.github/workflows/ci.yml` at head 2345bcd). This would have caught a gap in the merge gate after the summary job is gone. The summary job failed in three cases: (a) a `failure` or `cancelled` dependency; (b) a `skipped` `build`/`lint` on a non-mechanical PR; (c) a failure of the shared job, which leaves its dependents skipped. Case (a) is still covered because each job is now its own required check. Case (b) can only happen when `needs.checks.outputs.mechanical == 'true'` (`ci.yml:40`, `:53`). The summary job also passed in that case, so nothing changes. Case (c) is covered because `ci / checks` is itself required.
notCovered: Other repositories and live service behavior.

maintainable-no-slop.name: maintainable-no-slop
checked: Read the diff at head 2345bcd and the whole `.github/workflows/ci.yml` at the head sha. The change only deletes the `summary` job (base lines 37-63), with no line added or changed. This would have caught any new API, package, helper, abstraction layer or error-handling path. The diff has none.
notCovered: Other repositories and live service behavior.

voice.summary: Reviewed against the summoned lenses; no blocking findings.
